playbookOutputs: Nil IRP6 submitted on eFiling for the period
playbookCommonFailures: Taxpayer did earn taxable income in the period, so a nil estimate exposes them to the underestimation penalty (para 20 Fourth Schedule)
Wrong period selected (1st = first 6 months, 2nd = full year; 3rd voluntary top-up)
Taxpayer not registered as a provisional taxpayer so no IRP6 is issued on eFiling
OTP not relayed within the timeout

informationToProvide.label: Company / Taxpayer Name, SARS Tax Number & Provisional Period (e.g., 2026-01 or 2026-02)
informationToProvide.helpText: Registered company or individual name, 10-digit SARS Income Tax reference number, and the provisional period (YYYY-01 or YYYY-02).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Taxpayer name, 10-digit SARS Income Tax number, and IRP6 period (YYYY-01 or YYYY-02).

informationToProvide.label: Confirmation of Zero Taxable Income for the Tax Year
informationToProvide.helpText: Confirm in writing that the taxpayer had R0 taxable income (or an assessed loss) for the relevant tax year.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Written confirmation from client that estimated taxable income for the tax year is R0.

informationToProvide.label: Relevant SARS Provisional Tax Correspondence / ITA34 (optional)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload any SARS notice or latest ITA34 showing the basic amount.
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS provisional tax notice or latest ITA34 assessment.

informationToProvide.label: Signed Power of Attorney (if My Accountant is not yet linked)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload signed Power of Attorney if My Accountant is not yet linked on eFiling.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed Power of Attorney authorizing My Accountant to file on SARS eFiling.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Your SARS eFiling login username (or confirm if My Accountant already has Registered Representative / Tax Practitioner shared access).
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS eFiling username for the taxpayer profile or confirmation of shared Tax Practitioner access.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: Encrypted and restricted to authorized filing staff and the SARS eFiling automation worker.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Does logging into your SARS eFiling profile trigger a One-Time PIN (OTP) to your cellphone or email?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Whether 2FA OTP relay is required when logging into SARS eFiling.

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select a date and time window when you will be available to relay the real-time SARS OTP within the 10-minute eFiling timeout.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Preferred date/time window to coordinate real-time SARS eFiling OTP relay.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect eFiling access and nil confirmation
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Credentials on file, period identified and client has confirmed in writing that the return is nil
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ask for the eFiling username/password and confirm which period the IRP6 is for. Get an explicit written confirmation in Communication History that the taxpayer expects zero taxable income for the full year of assessment (not just no cash received). Do not promise a turnaround shorter than 1–2 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify period and that a nil return is appropriate
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Return is outstanding on eFiling for that period and nothing on file contradicts the nil declaration
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Identify the period: P1 due end of August (6 months into the year), P2 due end of February (year-end) for Feb year-ends; companies use their own financial year. Confirm the IRP6 for that period is issued under Returns → Provisional Tax (IRP6). Note the "basic amount" SARS shows — a nil estimate below the basic amount is allowed but is still an estimate. If evidence contradicts a nil return (e.g. an IRP5 with salary above the threshold, rental income, or a prior ITA34 with taxable income and no change in circumstances), stop and raise a proposal to switch to the trading version of this service.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit the nil IRP6 on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: IRP6 shows status Filed/Submitted for the period and the confirmation is saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Returns → Provisional Tax (IRP6) → select the period. Enter estimated taxable income = 0, tax = 0, employees' tax and prior provisional payments = 0 unless the profile shows otherwise. Check no penalty/interest lines are pre-populated. Stage with a screenshot of the completed return for Kevin's approval before Submit. eFiling login from a new device/IP triggers an OTP to the taxpayer's registered cell/email: pause, raise an otpRequest on the portal job via the OTP relay (Kevin, or the client through the Communication History link if allowed), 10-minute timeout then fail cleanly and reschedule. Never store OTPs. If a CAPTCHA appears, fall back to hand-off mode with the handoff sheet. Prefer filing from our practitioner profile if the taxpayer is already linked as a client; otherwise use the client's own login. If the taxpayer is not registered for the tax type on eFiling, stop and raise a proposal — do not activate tax types without Kevin.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver proof of submission
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Submission confirmation / filed return PDF posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the filed IRP6. Explain in plain English that the nil estimate was based on the client's confirmation and that if income does arise before year-end a revised estimate (2nd period or voluntary 3rd) avoids penalties; offer the trading IRP6 service.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
